title: Connector
description: Implementation binding — how a Capability is fulfilled against a backend system.

type.description: Connector protocol. MVP supports rest only.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the backend (may use env placeholder)

path.description: URL path (may include {param} placeholders from input)

name.description: Wire query-param name, when different from the CDL field name

explode.description: List-field wire form: true (default) repeats the key (tags=a&tags=b); false comma-joins (tags=a,b). Meaningful only for a `list:`-typed field.

onQuery.description: This field belongs on the query string even on a method that also carries a body (issue #63); it is excluded from the JSON body.

query.description: CDL input field name -> wire query-param name (a bare string), or an object form carrying `name`/`explode`/`onQuery` (#63). Unmapped fields fall back to their CDL name unchanged.

sql.description: ADR-0012: a database as a first-class backend. Postgres only, read-only, in v1.

engine.description: The Postgres wire family only in v1 (ADR-0012 D-2) — not a portable multi-engine abstraction.

dsn.description: An env-placeholder ONLY — exactly one ${VAR}, nothing else. A literal connection string is refused at `apply` (BR-2).

statementKind.description: Closed to `select` in v1 (BR-3) — writes are a later, narrower increment, not built here.

query.description: The entire declared, parameterized SQL text. Never templated with a caller-influenced value — there is no ${caller.NAME} substitution in this grammar, on purpose (D-1).

params.description: Ordered list of declared CDL input field names, bound positionally to the query's $1..$n placeholders (BR-5).
